title: Digital generation and long-term evaluation of socio-ecological snapshots in head and neck cancer patients using a mobile app, and their comparison with clinical data to test the impact of various therapeutic approaches depending on tumor type and prognostic factors
summary:
Head and neck tumors and their treatment can impair swallowing, speech, and physical activity. These limitations often affect the daily lives and quality of life of those affected.

The goal of this study is to investigate how the disease and its treatment affect physical activity, communication, and quality of life in patients with head and neck tumors. To this end, data on daily activity and smartphone use, as well as information from questionnaires regarding swallowing difficulties, voice problems, and quality of life, will be collected over an extended period. This data will be compared with information on the disease and its treatment.

The results are intended to help better understand the effects of head and neck tumors and their treatment. In the long term, they are expected to contribute to the early identification of patients at increased risk for persistent symptoms and to the targeted improvement of follow-up care and rehabilitation.
conditions: Malignant neoplasms of lip, oral cavity and pharynx
Malignant neoplasm of other and ill-defined sites
Malignant neoplasm of nasal cavity and middle ear

interventions.name: Patients with head and neck tumors are surveyed weekly about their swallowing and speech difficulties, quality of life, activity levels, and communication.
